description: This Java source file implements services related to Bills of Materials (BOM) in the manufacturing module of Apache OFBiz. It provides methods for calculating product low-level codes, BOM tree retrieval, component extraction, and shipment package creation, among others.

classes.name: BOMServices
classes.description: Contains static methods providing BOM-related services such as depth calculation, low-level code updates, BOM tree retrieval, component extraction, and shipment package creation.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth (low level code) of a product in BOMs, optionally filtered by BOM type.

methods.name: updateLowLevelCode
methods.description: Computes and updates the low level code for a product and its descendants considering manufacturing BOMs.

methods.name: initLowLevelCode
methods.description: Initializes low level codes for all products based on manufacturing BOMs.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Finds a duplicate ancestor in BOM relationships to prevent loops.

methods.name: getBOMTree
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a BOM tree for a product, optionally configured with quantity and amount.

methods.name: getManufacturingComponents
methods.description: Extracts manufacturing components from a product's BOM, including routing info.

methods.name: getNotAssembledComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components of a product that are not yet assembled.

methods.name: createShipmentPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages and their contents based on shipment data.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Returns products grouped in packages for a given product.
